evidence_spans.snippet: The slave address byte contains the 7-bit DS3231 address, which is 1101000
SCL Clock Frequency                                               | f SCL    | Fast mode     | 100    |       |   400 | kHz
Temperature Conversion Time                                       | t CONV   |               | 125    |       |   200 | ms
Bit 5: Convert Temperature (CONV). Setting this bit to 1 forces the temperature sensor to convert the temperature into digital code
The CONV bit remains at a 1 from the time it is written until the conversion is finished, at which time both CONV and BSY go to 0.
